notes: NEWEST Google foldable as of 2026-09-13 -- announced 2026-08-12, on sale 2026-08-20; it supersedes the Pixel 10 Pro Fold, which is still buyable on store.google.com but no longer the current model. URL TRAP: the locale-less store.google.com/product/pixel_11_pro_fold_specs renders client-side and yields no spec text; the /gb/ and /us/ locale paths return the full spec table to a plain curl. Dimensions and mass come from the en-GB page, which prints native MILLIMETRES; display diagonals come from the en-US page, which prints inches ('6.5-inch', '8-inch') -- the en-GB page gives only rounded inches for dimensions (6.1 x 3 x 0.4 in / 8.4 oz), so NO conversion was performed in either direction. Google states a new 'gearless hinge' with 'improved crease performance, thanks to the new hinge's larger bend radius' -- that is crease PERFORMANCE, not crease SHAPE, so crease is null. No free-stop claim -> null. blog.google adds that the back cover is a glass fibre composite 'designed to be nearly impossible to crack'; the spec page's own wording ('Ultra-durable composite matte back') is what is recorded in materials.back. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence).
